name: Monoamine degradation by MAO/COMT and serotonin synthesis
rationale: All members concern serotonin/catecholamine turnover, mainly MAO- and COMT-driven oxidative catabolism, and unlike the catecholamine transport/uptake and norepinephrine-biosynthesis confusables the theme carries serotonin biosynthesis and secretion.

name: Cytokinesis and post-mitotic nuclear envelope reassembly
rationale: Members cover contractile/septin ring, furrow and midbody abscission plus ESCRT-III nuclear envelope sealing and reassembly, whereas confusables emphasise envelope disassembly, spindle midzone or endoreduplication.

name: Fc-gamma receptor signalling in ADCC and hypersensitivity
rationale: Members are FCGR activation, inhibitory/stimulatory Fc signalling, ADCC and type I/II/IV hypersensitivity and antigen-driven acute inflammation, distinct from FCGR phagocytosis and Fc-epsilon mast cell confusables.

name: Regulation of cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation and regeneration
rationale: All members regulate cardiac muscle cell proliferation, growth, differentiation or regeneration, unlike confusables about heart morphogenesis or stress hypertrophy and adaptation.

name: Regulation of leukocyte endothelial adhesion and extravasation
rationale: Members regulate leukocyte adhesion to endothelium, adhesion-molecule production, diapedesis and neutrophil/T cell extravasation, without the integrin/shear-stress or monocyte-activation content of the confusables.

qualifier: APP synthesis and catabolism rather than amyloid-beta clearance
name: Regulation of amyloid precursor protein synthesis and catabolism
rationale: The specific members regulate APP biosynthesis and catabolism (the obsolete amide-metabolism terms are generic parents), whereas confusables concern amyloid-beta clearance, fibrils and glial activation.

qualifier: pharyngeal pouch derivatives, palate and spleen
name: Pharyngeal pouch organ, palate and spleen development
rationale: Members are development of thyroid, parathyroid and thymus (pharyngeal pouch derivatives), hard and soft palate and spleen, unlike the forebrain, limb, neural plate and outflow-tract confusables.

qualifier: translational control and PERK/IRE1 branch regulation
name: Unfolded protein response translational control via PERK and IRE1
rationale: Members regulate stress-induced translation initiation, PERK and IRE1 UPR branches and ER-stress apoptosis, lacking the ATF6/XBP1 chaperone-gene and mitochondrial/HRI/GCN2 stress content of confusables.

name: ER quality-control retention, demannosylation and retrotranslocation
rationale: Members cover ER export control, ERQC demannosylation and ER-to-cytosol retrotranslocation for ERAD, unlike confusables on SRP targeting/membrane insertion, COPII export or misfolded-protein response and reticulophagy.

qualifier: olfaction and pheromone rather than taste
name: Olfactory and pheromone chemosensation and olfactory system development
rationale: Most members concern olfactory receptors, smell, pheromone and odorant response and nose/olfactory nerve/GnRH neuron development (a few outliers like saliva, nicotine and alcohol likely ride on receptor genes), distinguishing it from taste-perception confusables.

name: Cyclooxygenase-dependent prostanoid synthesis and signalling
rationale: Members cover arachidonate release, COX reactions, prostaglandin/thromboxane synthesis, secretion, receptors and fever, distinct from leukotriene/lipoxin and P450 epoxygenase/hydroxylase confusables.

name: Ketone body metabolism and carnitine-mediated fatty acid shuttle
rationale: Members are ketone body synthesis/utilisation and carnitine transport, shuttle and deficiency, without the acyl-CoA beta-oxidation steps that define the confusables.

name: Macrophage colony-stimulating factor signalling and macrophage proliferation
rationale: All three members concern M-CSF signalling and macrophage proliferation, unlike confusables on microglial activation or IL-6-family cytokines.

name: SLIT-ROBO receptor signalling to Rho-family GTPases
rationale: Members are ROBO receptor signalling via ABL, AKAP5, RHOA activation and CDC42/RAC1 inactivation, whereas confusables cover ephrin/netrin/L1 guidance or SLIT-ROBO commissural axon pathfinding.

name: RIG-I/MDA5 cytosolic dsRNA sensing and its regulation
rationale: Members are RIG-I-like receptor signalling, its positive and negative regulators and dsRNA antiviral responses, lacking the TRAF/IRF interferon output, viral-evasion and DNA-sensing content of confusables.

qualifier: proteasome assembly and HIV Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation
name: Proteasome assembly and HIV Nef/Vpu-mediated immune receptor downregulation
rationale: Members combine proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-proteasome antigen processing with HIV Nef/Vpu degradation of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC-I, unlike confusables on MHC loading/cross-presentation or PD-L1 turnover.

qualifier: lipoylation-dependent PDH, OGDH, BCKDH and OADH
name: Lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and protein lipoylation
rationale: Members are PDH, OGDH, OADH and BCKDH reactions, MSUD/DLD defects, glycine cleavage and protein lipoylation, distinct from CoA synthesis, TCA cycle, BCAA catabolism defects and B6/serine confusables.

qualifier: trophectoderm, inner cell mass and germline
name: Peri-implantation trophectoderm, inner cell mass and germline specification
rationale: Members cover trophectoderm/giant-cell differentiation with endoreduplication, inner cell mass, primordial germ cell and stem cell maintenance and decidualization, lacking the labyrinth placenta and germ-cell meiosis content of confusables.

qualifier: p53 control and G2 arrest after ionizing radiation
name: p53 regulation and G2 checkpoint after ionizing radiation
rationale: Members are TP53 degradation/phosphorylation, G2 DNA damage checkpoint, Cdc25A degradation, CDK inhibition, senescence and gamma/X-ray responses, unlike confusables on normal G2/M progression, p53 apoptosis/ARF or AKT.

name: TGF-beta SMAD2/3 transcription and RUNX3 target regulation
rationale: Members are SMAD2/3:SMAD4 transcription and its downregulation plus RUNX3 regulation of ARF, BIM, CDKN1A and YAP1, lacking the receptor-mutant, BMP/activin and TGFBR3 content of confusables.

qualifier: nucleic acid sensing and type I interferon induction
name: Nucleic acid sensing and type I interferon antiviral response
rationale: Members span endosomal TLR3/7/8/9, RIG-I and cytosolic DNA sensing, IRF3/7 and type I/III interferon induction and ISG responses, far broader than dengue, cGAS-STING or PKR confusables.

qualifier: caspase-4/5, AIM2 and NLRC4 with IL-18
name: Caspase-4/5, AIM2 and NLRC4 inflammasome pyroptosis and IL-18
rationale: Members are pyroptosis via CASP4/5 non-canonical, AIM2 and IPAF inflammasomes, GBP bacterial defence and IL-18 signalling, distinct from NLRP1/NLRP3 IL-1 and apoptotic/necroptotic confusables.

qualifier: ER and endosomal compartments, inositol phosphate turnover
name: ER and endosomal phosphoinositide and inositol phosphate metabolism
rationale: Members are PIP synthesis at ER and early/late endosomes, phosphoinositide dephosphorylation and IP2/IP/inositol metabolism, unlike confusables on Golgi/plasma membrane PIPs or membrane traffic and lipid transfer.

name: Presynaptic clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle endocytosis and recycling
rationale: Members regulate synaptic vesicle endocytosis, recycling, clustering, clathrin coat assembly/disassembly and active zone structure, lacking the docking/priming/release cycles and postsynaptic receptor trafficking of confusables.

name: Tryptophan catabolism via the kynurenine pathway
rationale: All members describe tryptophan breakdown to and through kynurenine, distinct from threonine, histidine, tyrosine and glycine-conjugation confusables.
